title: Organiser dashboard — visual world (round 2)
question: Fresh directions. The roll assigned Suburban League Fixture Board.

options.label: Suburban League Fixture Board
options.thesis: Your hub is the laminated fixture board above the canteen—this week's sessions in ruled rows, sales inked in the margin, fill counts circled in marker.
options.viewport: Grid header with organiser name and week range; four stat cells across the top row; weekly bar chart as attendance ticks down the left margin; fixture rows with time, venue, fill fraction, and circled sold-out marks.
options.risk: Whiteboard metaphor can look cheap if marker textures become decoration without function.

options.label: One-Bit Desktop
options.thesis: Each metric lives in its own draggable window on a dithered desktop—marching ants around your selection, pixel icons for quick links.
options.case: Strongest modular clarity: KPIs, chart, and fixtures each own a window you can scan independently.
options.viewport: Dithered grey desktop with three overlapping windows titled Sales, Tickets, Fixtures; Chicago caps in title bars; 32px pixel icons along the bottom dock.
options.risk: Nostalgia can read as gimmick if dither patterns slow comprehension.

options.label: Swimming Carnival Heat Sheet
options.thesis: Sessions are heats in a ruled grid—lane numbers, seed times, and fill status in the columns every volunteer official reads.
options.case: Strongest audience identification: every community organiser has held one of these.
options.viewport: Heat sheet header with carnival name and date; KPI row as official summary strip; chart as lane-fill bars; upcoming events as heat rows with lane and capacity columns.
options.risk: Swimming-specific columns need careful translation for mixed sports.

options.label: Sneaker Archive Wall
options.thesis: Events stack like shoeboxes—end labels show session name, colorway accent, and size-run fill counts; pull a box to open details.
options.case: Fuses poorly: box-stack browsing fights time-ordered fixture scanning.
options.viewport: Wall of stacked box ends with session names in condensed caps; selected box slides half-out; tissue-fold reveal for event detail.
options.risk: Fashion archive metaphor distances grassroots sport organisers.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: Four KPI cards, bar chart, event list, quick-nav strip—Honest Clubhouse tokens at full craft.
canonCard.viewport: Grey canvas with four-up metrics, chart and events in two columns, bottom quick links.
canonCard.risk: Familiar pattern may not feel like a redesign.
